title: SIDESTORY: GUIDE AHEAD OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: GUIDE AHEAD OPEN
EVENT DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 7, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Guide Ahead event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
EVENT STAGES DURATION:
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
[Summit of Nations] Duration: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Road to the Shrine] Duration: September 23, 2022, 16:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[NOTARIAL TASKS]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Notarial Tasks] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Enforcer, Laterano Notarial Hall Lounge Furniture (Pieces), Etched Bullet Casings.
[LATERANIAN DESSERTS]
DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – October 7, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Etched Bullet Casings by clearing event stages. Etched Bullet Casing can be used to redeem items from [Lateranian Desserts].
MAIN REWARDS: Enforcer's Token, Laterano Notarial Hall Lounge Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
NOTE:
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – FLAME OF IMMACULACY
DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "Flame of Immaculacy", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Fiammetta
★★★★★: Kazemaru / Executor
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE IN HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Fiammetta
★★★★★: Kazemaru
★★★★★: Enforcer
NOTE:
Operator Enforcer is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Guide Ahead. Operator Enforcer is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
Operator Fiammetta and Kazemaru will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
Operator Fiammetta, Kazemaru, and Enforcer will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Appreciate Fragrance for Saileach
EPOQUE Collection - Plant Crude Drug for Mulberry
EPOQUE Collection - Cultivate Vegetation for Tuye
05 STRIKER SERIES RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
Striker Series – Skyline for Schwarz
Striker Series - Overload for Liskarm
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – LATERANO NOTARIAL HALL LOUNGE
DURATION: September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Laterano Notarial Hall Lounge, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Guide Ahead event rewards and redeem in Lateranian Desserts (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
The furniture pieces of this furniture set will be available at the Store from September 16, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) – September 30, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7).
